reviews.text: For me, they are unique... professionalism, reliability, competence, great empathy, and above all, humanity!!! Alessandro is beyond any possible evaluation.

A wonderful experience in every way. Their expertise, professionalism, helpfulness, kindness, empathy, honesty, and gentleness with animals were exceptional. I was fortunate to have met them and I recommend them to anyone.

This review is for Dr. Colangeli only; I don't know the other professionals. I went to this doctor because I got a phobic dog from a shelter. He came to my house, and after several rounds of contact, he stated that something was wrong with my other dog as well (he's 10 years old and doing fine, just a little territorial). He prescribed both of them a medication, and then he disappeared. The cost of the visit: €180. I write to him, but he doesn't respond. The dog is getting worse and worse, and he doesn't offer the slightest bit of support to the family. So, everyone is doing well...
Professional and above all kind. Recommended!!

Serious, kind, and professional! I've been walking my Labradors for over twenty years!
And I still do! 🙏❤️💯🔝👍 …

I've been going there for about twenty years, to my complete satisfaction, both for myself and my dogs. They're knowledgeable, helpful, and friendly. I used to live close to the studio, but I haven't changed even after moving far away.

Since Dr. Colangeli has been treating my French bulldog, she's been doing great. He's attentive, thorough, and honest, as well as having many years of experience. It's as if he's "talking" to my dog. In his absence, I've also had the opportunity to appreciate the other veterinarians, who, while not directly treating the dog, are very helpful and thorough.

My vets for all my dogs and cats for the last thirty years. Excellent, highly competent. A special mention for Dr. Arrighi, who combines clinical expertise with a blend of intelligence, culture, humor, and a direct approach that I greatly appreciate.

A practice run by highly trained, experienced doctors, immensely compassionate and helpful. Honest and always up-to-date. Their expertise also includes instrumental examinations, ultrasounds, and X-rays. I trusted them many years ago and continue to do so with great confidence, even with my two current four-legged friends. Dr. Arrighi made a long life possible for my beloved dachshund, before them. Trust these great professionals with peace of mind.
Very kind and qualified staff. After much wandering, I finally found a reputable veterinary practice.
Excellent, competent, and very kind doctors. Highly recommended.
Highly trained and experienced veterinarians. Kind, honest, and pet-loving.
I would have liked a more in-depth view of weighing the cat but no, everything was hasty.
